title: [Extensibility Request] issue 30401: add credit memo sales line filter event
summary: An integration event OnUpdateSalesDocumentOnBeforeFindSetCreditMemoSalesLine was added to the Sales-Post Prepayments codeunit, allowing extensions to filter credit memo sales lines during prepayment document processing.
key_points: New integration event fires before credit memo lines are queried
Extensions can add custom filters while preserving existing prepayment logic
Event added to all localization layers (W1, BE, CH, ES, FI, IT, APAC, NA, NL)
quote: Extensions need to refine which credit memo sales lines are processed when a prepayment document updates the originating sales document.
